model.name: scoreboard() throws on undefined.length — the chain-scoreboard roll-up cannot run
model.description: The chain-scoreboard summary function scoreboard() THROWS on undefined.length when invoked, so it cannot produce the N/M roll-up. Surfaced by the skill-expert while delivering the R40.84 measurement. This is the summary Tron would read to see his OWN totals: the per-chain credit is now CORRECT (label false-open fixed 8693dc2b, isolated +1), but the ROLL-UP that aggregates it cannot run. Root is UNDIAGNOSED/UNOWNED (captured symptom-first, do-not-diagnose). DISTINCT from the R40.84 label false-open (strict-AST reading the requirement-id as the method-token, fixed) and from the false-open scorer bug. Tooling = scripts/campaign-scoreboard.mjs / campaign-scoreboard-region.ts family (scoreboard requirement R30.11 measures the walked chain; R24.3 chain-scoring skill).
